item.text: The public bookmark path requires a numeric `localID`, so returning `null` also means the caller needs to skip `resumeSession` when there is no valid persisted ID. I’ll preserve the existing last active account selection, restrict session candidates to numeric `ps-` suffixes, and make fallback selection require a usable `persistedAt`.

The helper now returns `null` for an empty or unusable session set, ignores nonnumeric `ps-` keys, and never writes to storage. The bookmark hook only attempts session resume when it has a real local ID, then continues bookmark loading if no resumable ID exists. I’m running the Drive helper’s existing Jest test now.
